data.title: Trump shares bizarre AI video as family of UK tiger attack victim begs public to stop sharing footage
data.description: The family of a 23-year-old man killed by a tiger at a wildlife park in northern England has urged people to stop sharing footage of the fatal incident, saying its circulation was causing them severe distress. The appeal came after US President Donald Trump posted the video on his social media platform, Truth Social.
